painpoints.text: Sandbox lacks java, making the pinned TS client regen (bun run generate in lib/packages/fabro-api-client) fail with 'java: not found' per the fabro-d016 assumption. Workaround that worked (run 01M30B93PGSX0KF6D8ZVKCYVCM, seed fabro-f94d): 'mise install java@temurin-26' then 'mise use -g java@temurin-26.0.2+101' — the global mise use is required because the openapi-generator-cli child process resolves java through the mise shim and a PATH export alone fails. Durable fix idea: bake java into the toolchain image or server env config so client-regen seeds need no environment mutation.

observations: typescript-axios expands $ref parameters by value: the spec's RunsRepository parameter appears in generated code as the 'repository' query param on listRuns, never as the literal string 'RunsRepository' — acceptance criteria written as literal greps against $ref names will look unmet while the semantic content is present (lib/packages/fabro-api-client/src/api/runs-api.ts, run 01M30B93PGSX0KF6D8ZVKCYVCM).

Regen picked up two pre-existing pending spec drifts beyond the seed's target: first_token_timeout_secs in models/run-model-settings.ts and an apostrophe-escape doc-comment change in models/provider.ts — both are pinned-generator output, disclosed in the implementation summary.

The regen inserted 'repository' mid-signature in listRuns (between workflow and createdSince), a breaking positional change for any positional-argument callers of the TS client's listRuns — no such callers exist in this repo's packages, but downstream consumers should switch to named/object args.

Verified the regen is genuine generator output by cross-checking incidental drift: first_token_timeout_secs exists in fabro-api.yaml (line 15742) and the provider.ts escape change only makes sense as generator-version behavior — both argue against a hand-mirror.

The listRuns positional signature changed (repository inserted before created_since) — breaking for positional callers; disclosed by implementer and inherent to typescript-axios $ref inlining. Callers inside apps/fabro-web should use object-arg form; flag if a future seed hits a positional call.
